basic-probability.explain: A spam filter is a probability calculator. It counts how often words like 'free' and 'win' appear in spam and in normal email, multiplies those fractions, and picks the more likely group. Data scientists build and tune these models.
basic-probability.task:
The code learned from 8 emails: 4 spam and 4 not spam (ham). 'free' is in 3 of the 4 spam emails and 1 of the 4 ham emails. 'win' is in 2 of the 4 spam emails and 1 of the 4 ham emails. A new email contains 'free' and 'win'. By hand, work out:
  score_spam = P(spam) x P(free in spam) x P(win in spam)
  score_ham = P(ham) x P(free in ham) x P(win in ham)
  p_spam = score_spam / (score_spam + score_ham)
Write one line each, like: score_spam = 4/8 * 3/4 * 2/4 = ...
